item.title: Senkou no Clarias
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Team Baldrhead
  • 発売日: 2021-02-26
  • スコア: 6.859999999999999/10 (104 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 閃鋼のクラリアス
  • 英語名: Senkou no Clarias

别名

  • The armor of glittering Clarias

あらすじ

While on a field trip to London, Nagai Towa gets lost in the city at night.

After he finally makes it to the train station, he finds a mysterious egg.

“What’s with this egg? It’s really pretty…”

And then right before his eyes, the egg shatters into pieces. His consciousness fades away…

item.title: SKY & HEART LAST SURVIVAL
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Team Baldrhead
  • 発売日: 2017-12-22
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: SKY & HEART LAST SURVIVAL
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Sky & Heart Last Survival contains a survival mode similar to the survival modes of the previous games, and ero scenes for a few of the Fei from Baldr Heart. In the survival mode you play as Sou, and you have all weaponry from both Baldr Heart and Baldr Heart EXE aside from the collaboration weapons. Almost all units from Baldr Sky, Baldr Sky DiveX and Baldr Heart are present as enemies (collaboration units from Baldr Sky DiveX are missing).

item.title: Material Brave Ignition
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Team Baldrhead
  • 発売日: 2013-01-25
  • スコア: 7.63/10 (76 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マテリアルブレイブ イグニッション
  • 英語名: Material Brave Ignition

あらすじ

This is the fandisc for the action adventure Material Brave, consisting of after stories for the 5 heroines, as well as a new story for the childhood friend Ena. There are additional dungeons during the ADV/ACT part, with new weapons and outfits.

After an all-out battle with Ena, Ayumu lost his unleashed powers and Ena fell into a deep sleep as a cocoon-shaped enigmatite. He set out to recover his powers and bring Ena back to normal, but hurried back to Kamioshiro-jima when he heard that the research facility where Ena was being held was being attacked by a new type of Neoplasm. Ayumu suffered serious injuries while trying to fight them off without his powers. He touched Ena’s cocoon and there was a flash of light, with Ena’s pained voice warning him about a new enemy which would be the beast of the apocalypse. His unleashed powers returned to him and his teammates were happy to welcome him back as their leader, but many mysteries and challenges await them.

item.title: Material Brave
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Team Baldrhead
  • 発売日: 2012-03-23
  • スコア: 7.42/10 (183 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マテリアルブレイブ
  • 英語名: Material Brave

あらすじ

Kamioki-jima is an island close to Japan which was recently formed due to volcanic activity and is home to one of the rarest minerals, enigmatite. Living beings which fuse with enigmatite gain great powers. Such humans are known as “unleashed”, while animals and plants are known as “neoplasm” (NP). To research the hidden powers behind enigmatite, the island was designated a special area with a school to train the unleashed, called the “Unleashed Nursery”.

item.title: Otome Crisis
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Team Baldrhead
  • 発売日: 2008-03-28
  • スコア: 6.85/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: オトメクライシス
  • 英語名: Otome Crisis

あらすじ

This is a story of Laurier, who makes girls small like dolls and add them to her collection, and Hiiro, who pursues her across dimensions. Just when Hiiro captures her, she tries to go to another dimension. Hiiro tries to stop her, but Laurier disappears. A while later, several girls suddenly come out of a crack! They are the girls Laurier keeps in her collection. She jumps into the crack to save them…

It’s the future where the technology is being over-used and at the same time conflicts between countries and religion occur which causes a loss in theory and technology. The world is now in corrupted towns with ruins of ancient technology everywhere. The story takes place in future Japan,and the hero of the game is an ex-mercenary called Bloody Baldy who earns his living by being an armament banker…
